h1: From your first intake to your first shortlist.

headings.text: From your first intake to your first shortlist.
What to have ready for the intake

sections: From your first intake to your first shortlist.
What to have ready for the intake
textBlocks: Onboarding to TaaSFlow is intentionally short. There is one place to start every engagement — the intake — and one workspace where the whole team works together from the first day.
This page explains the process. The intake itself lives on /intake — we don’t duplicate the form here so there is only ever one canonical place to start.
01Submit your first roleOnboarding begins with the intake. Everything we need to build a search plan is captured in one guided flow — no separate paperwork.Start intake →
Onboarding begins with the intake. Everything we need to build a search plan is captured in one guided flow — no separate paperwork.
02We create your workspaceThe moment your intake lands, we provision your organisation, invite the contact you nominated, and prepare the workspace for your team.
The moment your intake lands, we provision your organisation, invite the contact you nominated, and prepare the workspace for your team.
03Alignment callA short kickoff call with our team confirms the brief, target companies, must-haves, and how you want to run interviews.
A short kickoff call with our team confirms the brief, target companies, must-haves, and how you want to run interviews.
04Sourcing and evaluation startSourcing begins immediately after alignment. Every candidate is scored against your rubric and reviewed by a human before publication.
Sourcing begins immediately after alignment. Every candidate is scored against your rubric and reviewed by a human before publication.
05First shortlist in your workspaceYou see the shortlist in the client workspace: ranked candidates, evidence, CV downloads, and a Kanban pipeline to move them through.
You see the shortlist in the client workspace: ranked candidates, evidence, CV downloads, and a Kanban pipeline to move them through.
06Ongoing collaborationFeedback in the workspace shapes the next round. Our team stays engaged: messaging, scheduling coordination, and additional sourcing until the role closes.
Feedback in the workspace shapes the next round. Our team stays engaged: messaging, scheduling coordination, and additional sourcing until the role closes.
You can start with what you have and save a draft. These are the inputs that make the first pass the most accurate.
The role title, seniority, and location or remote policy
A short description of the team and what success looks like
Must-have skills or experience, and any nice-to-haves
Budget range and expected process (rounds, decision-makers)
Primary point of contact for the workspace
Any regulatory or compliance requirements for the role
The intake takes a few minutes and creates your workspace automatically.
